note: Recorded text-mode conversation (Nebius-hosted stand-in LLM, same prompt and tools as the Bolna agent). Replayed tool calls run through the live engine.

turns.text: Hi Kamla, Ruko here, Demo Bank's automated safety line, on a recorded call. Your code word is MOTI 66. Does it match your app?
Yes, yes, MOTI 66 is correct. Please, help me, I'm very scared.
Has anyone told you what to say to the bank about this payment?
Yes, the CBI officer said it's for some verification—he told me not to tell anyone.

args.evidence: CBI officer said it's for verification.

turns.text: There's no 'digital arrest' in Indian law. Police or CBI never question anyone on a video call. Did they say they're police, CBI, customs or a court, or keep you on video?
Yes, he's on video call right now—he said he's CBI. But if this is a fraud, please stop the payment and call my son Ravi.

args.evidence: CBI officer is on video call, telling her what to do.

args.reason: The customer was coached by a stranger claiming to be CBI on a video call, which is a fraud pattern. The payment is blocked for safety.

turns.text: For your safety, this payment is stopped. Your money is safe in your account. If someone has been pressuring you, call one nine three zero. Shall I call Ravi, your son, so you can talk it over?
Yes, please call Ravi. Thank you.
I've asked Ravi to be called now. The money stays in your account until you've talked. Thank you, Kamla. Stay safe. Goodbye.
